card: This pull request refactors the HTTP request parser by removing HTTPRequest::SetState, privatizing individual field loader methods, and introducing a single HTTPRequest::Load entry point to handle state transitions internally. It addresses an encapsulation gap left by PR 35829 where external callers could arbitrarily mutate request state. The change is an internal refactor with no bug fixes or performance impacts, directly following up on review feedback from PR 35829. It has no open PR dependencies.
evidence: Author references review discussion on merged PR #35829 (r3860447518) noting that anyone with a reference to a request could still update the internal state enum.
problem: After PR 35829 made HTTPRequest fields private, external callers could still arbitrarily mutate request state via SetState, and external callers were responsible for driving individual stage parsing methods. This left the HTTP request state machine exposed to external manipulation and kept HTTPRemoteClient parsing logic tightly coupled to manual state management.
scope_notes: Unit tests and fuzz tests are mechanically updated from invoking the three individual Load* methods to calling HTTPRequest::Load().
summary: Encapsulates HTTPRequest state transitions by removing SetState and making the individual LoadControlData, LoadHeaders, and LoadBody methods private. Adds a unified HTTPRequest::Load method that manages internal state progression and returns the updated state. Also refactors HTTPRemoteClient by inlining ReadRequest into an internal member helper.
